description: MobiVoc is an open vocabulary for mobility services and related data exchange. Its repository defines concepts and relationships intended to make records about new transport options interoperable across applications. A user can map service, trip or mobility-provider attributes to the published terms and export a structured representation for the places represented in their own data. The vocabulary does not have a fixed geographic coverage. The README explains its purpose, and GitHub metadata states CC BY 4.0 licensing. A limitation is that an ontology can standardise labels but cannot supply trip demand, network capacity or behavioural assumptions on its own. Implementers also need to check version stability and mapping choices against the data source. MobiVoc can help combine multimodal inputs for transport simulation and digital mobility platforms. The related catalogue AequilibraE model performs transport analysis but is not an ontology. No vocabulary file or dataset was downloaded.
